title: Anton Meier Ebsen Jørgensen – CV
description: Academic CV: MSc Economics student at the University of Copenhagen interested in economic history, demography and applied econometrics.

sidebar.subtitle: MSc Economics student · Economic history · Applied econometrics

text: I am an MSc Economics student at the University of Copenhagen with interests in economic history, demography, technology and inequality. My demography paper on Prussia’s Kulturkampf uses historical panel data and difference-in-differences, with particular attention to identification and alternative explanations. I expect to complete my MSc in January 2027.

I am writing a joint thesis on the economic history of slavery on St. Croix, supervised by Paul Sharp. My background also includes macroeconomics, programming and data work, alongside teaching Excel and VBA at Djøf.
Selected course grades: Demography 12 and AI for Humanity 10, on the Danish seven-point scale.
